name: Separation Margin
definition: For nonempty $C\subseteq\{0,1\}^n$, let $\mathcal M(C)$ be its minimal missing partial patterns. A $t$-certificate chooses $x^c\in\mathbb R^n$ for each $c\in C$ and coefficients $a_{p,i}\ge0$ summing to one on each $\operatorname{supp}p$, subject to $t\le(2c_i-1)x_i^c\le1$ and $\sum_i a_{p,i}\epsilon_{p,i}x_i^c\le-t$ for every $p,c$. Then $\mu(C)$ is the largest feasible $t\in[0,1]$.
normalization: Separator rows have $\ell_1$ norm one, witnesses have $\ell_\infty$ norm at most one, and the full cube, including the zero-dimensional cube, has margin one.
comments: Defined for every nonempty binary class. Positivity is exactly affine-convex realizability plus ampleness; no class of all binary set families has yet been promoted as a database endpoint.
